messages.content: I think I've been avoiding setting goals because I'm scared of failing them.
Honestly, that's a genuinely common form of self-protection. What would failing actually cost you, in your mind?
I think it would confirm that I'm not as capable as I want to believe.
That's honestly a heavy belief to be protecting yourself from - but not setting goals at all also confirms nothing gets tested, which isn't actually safer long-term.
I hadn't thought about it that way, honestly.
Glad that landed - a failed attempt still tells you something real, avoidance just delays finding out.
